subject: RapidPay Trial: success criteria, timeline & integration checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@rapidpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RapidPay trial — post-call recap & proposed POC plan

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed lightweight trial plan so we can get aligned on success criteria, timeline, and responsibilities. Please confirm or flag anything missing.

Goal: Validate Redwood can deliver predictable latency and classification accuracy for RapidPay's transaction-routing use case while meeting data controls.

Proposed POC (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff): share security docs, grant sandbox keys, confirm test dataset and evaluation queries.
- Week 1–2 (integration): integrate Redwood SDK for streaming inference, implement API route for transaction classification, and set up metric collection (latency, token cost, accuracy).
- Week 3 (eval): run evaluation suite against RapidPay sample dataset, collect logs and quality metrics.
- Week 4 (wrap): results review, handoff plan, and optional follow-on scope (dedicated capacity).

Success criteria (ask you to confirm):
- 95th percentile request latency < 120 ms for 1–2k concurrent inference flows (payloads ~200 tokens).
- Classification accuracy >= 98% on labeled transaction set provided by RapidPay.
- Per-transaction inference cost target: <$0.002 per inference (estimate; refine in Week 1).
- Integration: streaming responses or SSE acceptable; must support tool-calling for enrichment calls (e.g., auth lookups).
- Security: SOC2 evidence + audit log access during POC.

Owners:
- Redwood: Jonas (commercial), Priyom (integration lead), Neha (security/compliance).
- RapidPay: Samantha (product sponsor), Alex (engineering lead), Legal for T&Cs.

Next steps:
1) Samantha: confirm success criteria and test dataset availability.
2) RapidPay to provide engineering contact and preferred kickoff times.
3) Redwood to share POC checklist and sandbox credentials once paperwork is in order. (See attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx)

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to adjust the plan based on what you need.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0142

- Throughput: sustain 1.5k concurrent flows during load window; average payload size ~180 tokens.

Subject: RapidPay integration plan & API snippets

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Following up ahead of the kickoff — I put together an integration checklist and a few concrete snippets to make the first integration sprint frictionless. Attaching the short code file (sdk-integration-snippets.txt) to the shared folder. Quick summary here:

1) Recommended integration surface
- POST /v1/infer/classify — synchronous route for simple classification requests.
- /v1/stream/classify — streaming route (we support SSE and websockets). For your use case SSE is fine; we'll provide SSE example.
- Tool-calling: include 'tools' array in JSON payload to trigger server-side enrichment (e.g., auth lookup).

2) Example request (curl):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer/classify \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-2","input":"{transaction_payload}","options":{"max_tokens":60}}'

3) SSE example (Node.js):
const eventSource = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/classify?key=<SANDBOX_KEY>');
eventSource.onmessage = (e) => { /* handle chunk */ };

4) Tool-calling pattern
POST /v1/infer/call-tool with payload that includes 'tool_name' and 'args'. On the Redwood side we return a structured tool result which the model can consume in the next turn. Useful for lookups or enrichment without sending private keys to the model.

5) Observability hooks
- We will expose per-request token counts, 50/95/99 latency percentiles, and request-level trace ids that you can correlate from your side.

I also added a short list of acceptance checks for Week 3 evaluation in the redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (already uploaded).

Attachments posted to Drive: sdk-integration-snippets.txt, redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx

If you want, I can drop a 20-minute tech session before kickoff to walk Alex through the snippets.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Integration Lead | Redwood Inference
